info.description:
Internal API for REPUTAP — Smart Review Stand management system.
Manages customers, stores, orders, QR codes, NFC, production, QC, shipping, and scan analytics.
info.title: REPUTAP API

post.description: Authenticate admin user with email and password, returns JWT tokens
Logout current user (client should discard tokens)

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile info

post.description: Exchange a valid refresh token for new access and refresh tokens

parameters.name: search

get.description: Get a single customer by their ID

put.description: Update an existing customer by ID

Get the status change history of an order
